member.name: JsonRpc
member.summary: Classic JSON-RPC API (/jsonrpc) with login and password or API key - works with all Odoo versions. Deprecated since Odoo 19; removed in Odoo 22 (fall 2028) and Odoo Online 21.1 (winter 2027).

member.name: JsonApi
member.summary: JSON API of Odoo 19+ (called "JSON-2" in Odoo documentation, POST /json/2/<model>/<method>): no login, API key sent as bearer token, database in the X-Odoo-Database header, arguments passed by name. Put the API key into . Positional arguments are not supported by JSON API, so calls that need them (e.g. ) return a failed result - use with named arguments instead.
